canvas.$description: App canvas background (light). Contrast: base for text/primary (≥4.5:1).

disabled.$description: Disabled control fill (light). Contrast: with text/disabled.

tooltip.$description: Tooltip surface (light). Contrast: with text/on-inverse or on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong.$description: Strong neutral fill (light). Contrast: use text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

soft.$description: Soft neutral fill (light). Contrast: with text/neutral (≥4.5:1).

strong-hover.$description: Strong neutral hover (light). Neutral strong inverts (950), so hover lightens to 800 — not the chromatic 700 step. Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong-active.$description: Strong neutral active (light). Neutral strong inverts (950), so active lightens to 700 — not the chromatic 800 step. Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong.$description: Strong info fill (light). Contrast: use text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

soft.$description: Soft info fill (light). Contrast: with text/info (≥4.5:1).

strong.$description: Strong success fill (light). Contrast: use text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

soft.$description: Soft success fill (light). Contrast: with text/success (≥4.5:1).

strong.$description: Strong warning fill (light). Contrast: use text/on-strong-warning (≥4.5:1).

soft.$description: Soft warning fill (light). Contrast: with text/warning (≥4.5:1).

strong.$description: Strong danger fill (light). Contrast: use text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

soft.$description: Soft danger fill (light). Contrast: with text/danger (≥4.5:1).

strong-hover.$description: Strong danger hover (light). Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong-active.$description: Strong danger active (light). Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong.$description: Strong ai fill (light). Contrast: use text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

soft.$description: Soft ai fill (light). Contrast: with text/ai (≥4.5:1).

strong-hover.$description: Strong ai hover (light). Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

strong-active.$description: Strong ai active (light). Contrast: with text/on-strong (≥4.5:1).

primary.$description: Primary body text (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on canvas/surface.

tertiary.$description: Tertiary text (light). Contrast: ~4.33:1 on bg/canvas (neutral-50) — below AA for small text; use for non-essential copy or large type only, not primary readable body.

disabled.$description: Disabled text (light). Contrast: may be <4.5:1 by design for disabled state.

on-inverse.$description: Text on inverse surfaces (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on tooltip/inverse fills.

link-hover.$description: Link hover text (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on canvas.

on-strong.$description: Text/icons on strong fills (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on strong role fills (not warning).

on-strong-warning.$description: Text on warning strong (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on amber-300 — white fails; this is required.

neutral.$description: neutral text and status icons (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft neutral / canvas.

info.$description: info text and status icons (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft info / canvas.

success.$description: success text and status icons (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft success / canvas.

warning.$description: warning text and status icons (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft warning / canvas.

danger.$description: danger text and status icons (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft danger / canvas.

ai.$description: ai text and status icons (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on soft ai / canvas.

disabled.$description: Disabled icon (light). May be reduced contrast by design.

on-inverse.$description: Icon on inverse (light). Contrast: ≥3:1 / ≥4.5:1 if conveying meaning.

subtle.$description: Decorative trim. The card's fill contrast and shadow carry the container boundary; the outline is not load-bearing. Also table dividers and menu separators. Contrast: exempt from 3:1.

focus.$description: Focus ring color (light). Contrast: ≥3:1 against background.

bg-hover.$description: Selected hover fill (light). Contrast: with selected/text ≥4.5:1.

text.$description: Selected label text (light). Contrast: ≥4.5:1 on selected/bg.

field-hover.$description: Selected field hover wash (light). Contrast: with selected/text ≥4.5:1.
